manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 227
text:
Page 001
001-1. I'M HEADING OUT.
001-2. OKAY.
001-3. LITTLE HE DIDN'T PRACTICE SWORD- PLAYTODAY,BUT I'M PRACTICING MY MARTIAL ARTS!

Page 002
002-1. AS THIS CONTINUES, THE GAP BETWEEN US WILL NARROW LITTLE BY LITTLE. ALTHOUGH IT'S ONLY ALITTLE BIT, VICTORYLIES IN PERSEVERANCE!
002-2. YOU CAN'T BECOME A MASTERAFTERPRACTICING MARTIAL ARTS FOR A DAY, NOR CAN YOU BECOME SMART AFTER STUDYING FOR A DAY, PERSEVERANCE IS KEY! JIANG HE IS LIKE A MAX-LEVEL BOSS, WHILE I'M JUST A NOOB WITH AWOODENSWORDCOMINGOUT OF THE BEGINNER VILLAGE...
002-3. BUT AS LONG AS THERE IS ENOUGH TIME AND MY SKILL PROFICENCY SLOWLY INCREASES, SOONER ORLATER IWILL DEFEAT HER ANDCARRY HER TO BED!
002-4. ACHOO

Page 003
003-1. PINGPING!
003-2. JIANG HE!
003-3. COME HERE!
003-4. LOOK!
003-5. IT'S THE GUZHENG I BOUGHT!
003-6. WOW! THIS GUZHENG IS NOT SMALL ATALL!
003-7. IT'S AS BIG AS THE BIG SWORD!

Page 004
004-1. PLEASE HELP ME MOVE IT UPSTAIRS!
004-2. WANT TO LEARN?
004-3. I-1 WON'T BE ABLE TO LEARN IT, BUT XU QING SHOULO BE ABLE TO, HE SINGS VERY WELL!

Page 005
005-1. AIYAH, WHAT'S THE POINT OF HIM LEARNING IT? I THINK YOULL BE ABLE TO LEARN A BIT.
005-2. DOESN'T XU QING KNOW MARTIAL ARTS? YOU PLAY THE GUZHENG WHILE HE DISPLAYS HIS MOVES,IT WOULD BE EVEN BETTER IF HE KNEW THE SWORD.
005-3. TSK, YOU WANT HM TODANCEWITH A SWORD? HE HAS NO STRENGTH AT ALL, AND HIS HANDS STARTS TO FEEL SORE NOTLONG AFTERPRACTICING
005-4. I REALLY DON'T HAVE TIME TO LEARN.
005-5. THEN LET ME PERFORM A SONG FOR YOU. YOU

Page 006
006-1. C T/N: Pingping

Page 007
007-1. DOYOU WANT TO LEARN NOW?
007-2. .I WOn'T BE ABLE TO LEARN IT.
007-3. MYHANDS ARE USED TO WIELDING A SWORD, AND YET I STILL WANT TO DO THAT..

Page 008
008-1. JUST THINKING ABOUT IT FEELS WRONG.
008-2. I'LL BE TEACHING YOU! YOU TEACH ME HOW TO COOK, AND I'LL TEACH YOU HOW TO PLAY TUNES.
008-3. IT'S FINE, I STILL IT'S FINE,I STILL HAVE TO STUDY AND READ...STUDYING TOO READ..STUDYINGTOO MUCH CALSES MY BRAIN TO OVERLOAD.
008-4. 好好学习 天天向上！ YOU'RE STILL IN SCHOOL? I THOUGHT YOU...!
008-5. MATH
008-6. THIS IS DIFFERENT FROM WHAT I THOUGHT! LIVESTREAMING WITH XU QING EVERY DAY, GOING FISHING WITH ME, TEACHING ME HOW TO COOK.ANDYET SHE'S STILL A STUDENT!?
008-7. NO NO, Xu QInG WANTS TO ME STUDY ON MY OWN IN PREP- ARATION TO ENROLL INTO ADULT UNI- VERSITY.
008-8. I SEE.
008-9. HE WANTS YOU TO BRUSH UP ON YOUR KNOWLEDGE? THEN WHAT'S YOUR HIGHEST EDUCATION LEVEL? HIGH SCHOOL? 坐

Page 009
009-1. EIGHTH... GRADE.
009-2. NO MATTER HOW YOU LOOK AT IT, YOUCAN'T TELL THAT JIANG HE DIDN'T EVEN FINISH MIDDLE SCHOOL! SUCH A QUIET GIRL WHO LOVES READING ACT- UALLY ONLY HAD A MIDDLE SCHOOL EDUCATION?
009-3. I REMEMBER YOU SAID THAT XU QING GRADUATED FROM COLLEGE, RIGHT? I'M NOW REALLY CURIOUS HOWYOU TWO MET.
009-4. WHOKNEWACHEERFUL-LOOKING PERSONLIKEXUQINGWOULD DO SUCH A THANKLESSTASKASASKING HISGIRLFRIENDWHOISALREADY ABLETOMAKEMONEYTHROUGH LIVESTREAMINGTOSTUDY INORDER TOGETABETTEREDUCATION
009-5. SPEAKING OF WHICH, I HAVE ONLY SEEN HIM THROUGH THE LIVESTREAMAND NOT UP-CLOSE.
009-6. AH? DO YOU WANT TO GET TO KNOW HIM?
009-7. IT WOULD BE WEIRD IF I SAID YES. THAT'S YOUR BOYFRIEND, WHAT DO I NEED TO GET TO KNOW HIM FOR? I WAS JUST CURIOUS. SINCE YOU TWO LIVE TOGETHER, ARE YOUONE STEP AWAY FROM GETTING MARRIED?

Page 010
010-1. T-THAT'S STILL FAR AWAY!
010-2. YOU SEEMED TO COMPLAIN THAT HE KEPT FORCING YOU TO READ BOOKS IN THE PAST, ANDNOWHE WANTS YOU TO GET A BETTER ED- UCATION..HE'S REALLY HELPING YOU PLAN IT OUT!
010-3. YEAH, HE WANTS METO BECOME A MORE KNOWLEDGE- ABLE PERSON.
010-4. THIS YOUNG COUPLE...WHY AM IA LITTLE JEALOUS?
010-5. THIS MAN IS PLANNING FOR THE FUTURE, AND IT'S NOT THE NEXT THREE TO FIVE YEARS, BUT THE SECOND HALF OF THEIR LIVES.
010-6. IN HIS PLAN, THE TWO OF THEM WILL ALWAYS BE TOGETHER.

Page 011
011-1. WHY JEALOUS? ISN'T THIS NORMAL FOR SOMEONE YOU LIKE?
011-2. ...THE REASONS BEHIND IT ARE HEARTWARMING.
011-3. WHY NOT...

Page 012
012-1. CALL HIM OUT AND LET'S GO WALK AROUND?
012-2. W-WHAT ARE YOU TRYING TO DO..?! HE'S BUSY AND HAS-NOTIME!
